name: Panakala Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple

history.summary: The Guntur District tourism portal identifies Mangalagiri as a long-established pilgrimage centre and describes the Panakala Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy temple on Mangalagiri hill.

name_origin.summary: The district tourism material records Mangalagiri as meaning 'Auspicious Hill' and describes the deity as Panakala Narasimha Swamy because of the temple's traditional offering of jaggery water.

sources.title: Tourism | Guntur District
sources.publisher: Government of Andhra Pradesh, Guntur District
sources.supports: Identifies Mangalagiri as a pilgrimage centre and describes Panakala Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple.
